MOM IS BACK 💪❤️ Running again after 20 years 🏃🏻‍♀️ I wanted to surprise her 🥹 My mom used to be a runner and when I was a kid she took me to the track. Before every workout, we’d run a few laps together. Today, at 67 years young, I got to return the favor. After 20 years without running, my mom laced up her shoes and ran with me again. A simple run, but one of the most emotional moments we’ve ever shared. Some memories come back exactly as you left them. And some moments stay in your heart forever 🙏🏻 Happy Mother’s Day ✨ #running #motivation #love #mom #mothersday

To give some perspective on how big parkrun is, here are the stats from last weekends parkruns: Worldwide there were 2,164 parkruns plus 525 junior parkruns, 399,000 parkrunners plus 42,000 junior parkrunners, and 52,000 volunteers in total.     ~33,000 people got their parkrun barcode this week (registered for parkrun).  ~20,000 people became parkrunners this week  ~5,700 parkrunners joined running milestone clubs (There are ~2000 who have done 500 or more parkruns!!!)  ~ In the UK there were 876 parkruns  The US makes up less than 5% of global park runs!

My six star journey journey started to heal after losing my dad to cancer. When I got my six star here at the London Marathon in 2023 I finished hand in hand with my sister and that was meant to be the end of journey…but these races and the people that come to them are larger than life and inspired me. I came back a year later to chase a dream for myself, to run all the majors under 3 hours in one year, and I came damn close.  Today I finished the London marathon hand in hand again with the love of my life, in a new chapter. Today is a step into the future and while it hurts that Miri will never have known my dad, in a way, we all shared in this experience together.  London will always have a special place in my heart. I loved here once. My dad visited me here when he was healthy. I ran here in his honor. I’ve chased audacious goals here. A big piece of the rest of my life is here.  Love you London.

50km Woodlands Ultra Marathon🚀 Today I wanted to bring home the medal from the race and give it to my biggest inspiration… my Grandma Nanny Jan fighting for her life with throat cancer! There were heaps of highs and lows today in the race but just like anything in life you’ve gotta go through it and suffer cause the reward is beautiful at the end I misssd my bro Stef out there today with his torn hip labrum’s but he’s doing everything he can to get back out here to help raise more money for cancer The last slide we have created a f*ck cancer wall where we want to dedicate our runs to fans who have been impacted by cancer. Please DM us your cancer stories or your kids cancer stories and we will dedicate a run for you and stick you on the wall… let’s fill this wall up together ❤️ Thanks so much Brett and @trailsplus for putting on an epic event and having us today! Somehow this was my second fastest 50km💪

50km Ultra Marathon Woodlands🚀 Today was brutal… this trail race broke down Lach’s body! Our Grandma is fighting for her life with cancer and a brain aneurysm so Lach gave every bit of energy he had in this 50km race for her Lach didn’t expect this ultra marathon event to be so tough… his feet were so blistered after just 20km and the quads slowly destroyed his quads! He managed to run his second fastest 50km time ever in almost 6 hours! Nan i hope you enjoy this medal! Lach is pushing for all the beautiful people out there battling cancer❤️ #running #marathon #ultramarathon #asmr #fyp

Lorne half marathon🚀 Today we ran 23km with over 10,000 people… it was epic!  After 20km of rolling hills and wet condition our legs felt the pain… but we pushed to the finish!  This one was for our Grandma Nanny Jan… you continue to inspire us in your fight against cancer🙏 Big thanks to @Brooks Running  for putting on such a surreal event!  See you next week for another ultra marathon! Big love❤️ #running #marathon #ultramarathon #fyp

Today we ran the @Brooks Running Great Ocean Road half marathon🚀It was a challenging 23km in the rain, but we bloody loved it!  Congratulations to the 10,000+ people who signed up, running in the half marathon, marathon and even ultra! So many inspiring stories out there today.  Post run it was time to recover for our next half marathon in 3 days… so we headed straight to the @bestofthebone store to get back in those lost electrolytes and amino acids💪 Next up, was a high protein Fitness Outcomes pasta meal in combination with a freezing cold ice bath… this was prime recovery! We finished off by testing out the @Ecosa beds… the problem was once we lay down we didn’t want to leave😂 Finally thanks a lot to Great Ocean Road Running Festival for putting on a surreal event, all the volunteers were lovely and such a scenic run… definitely back next year!  Onto the next big run🐑 love you guys❤️

Only 1 month ago we both got MRI hip scans showing torn cartilage, bursitis and tendonitis…  It’s a long road back to full strength, but we are pushing through 1-2 times per week to give hope to people fighting, like our Nanny Jan.  Support the mission by donating via the link in our bio <3

Bayside half marathon🚀 Today was pissing down with rain and the joints felt bone on bone in the wet.  But I pushed through the discomfort in memory of Zoron, a 27 year old hero in our army who sadly passed away from cancer.  Zoron rest in peace you are a true hero! Si quieres saber porque hicimos historia en la edición 2026 de Wings for Life con @Red Bull Colombia 🇨🇴 exión es para ti: Muchas veces no nos damos cuenta de lo afortunados que somos.  Este fin de semana tuve el honor de lograr hacer la mayor cantidad de kms en equipo de 4 personas en Latinoamérica ( y 2 lugar en el mundo ) con @Patas Peludas (quedo 3 de colombia ) @hectorramirez_f (nuevo récord nacional de wflworldrun) y @mariacrun (nuevo récord nacional femenino de wflworldrun ) para recaudar fondos que van ayudar en la investigación de la médula espinal.  Sin embargo, haber logrado esto mostró algo triste y es ver que algunas personas creen que no tiene mérito hacer este tipo de cosas que buscan ayudar a personas que no pueden hacer lo que la mayoría de nosotros podemos hacer que es moverse… Ojalá lo que hicimos pueda inspirar a más personas a sumarse a esta y otras causas que busquen ayudar a personas que por x o y razón no pueden hacer cosas que las damos por dadas.  Correr es más que un deporte y esta carrera es la prueba de ello. A veces lo importante no es la medalla o el lugar en que quedas sino a quien puedes ayudar corriendo 🥹🙌 Nos vemos en la edición 2027 y espero que se armen muchos equipos para que nos quieren el récord y puedan demostrar hasta donde podemos llegar por una buena causa. Running is quite funny really isn't it... Willingly putting yourself through months of training, turning down social occasions and a lot of discomfort, all in the hope that one day you'll run faster than you ever have before. Which in the grand scheme of things, may seem meaningless. But at the same time, it must mean something to that person if they're willing to sacrifice so much for it. I always loved hearing Kipchoge talk about smiling during races because it relaxes the body and helps him deal with the pain a little better. And honestly, I think there's something quite beautiful in that. The harder it gets, the more important it becomes to find moments of lightness... not just in running, in everything. Smiling amongst the chaos. Reflecting the bad energies. Wish I could bottle this feeling up! Thanks @Jake Taylor for the epic clip ⚡️ #run #runner #running #matathon #marathontraining

A very important 5k with @Ben West 💙 Ben works for Mental Health Innovations - the team behind Shout @GiveUsAShout and The Mix, two services providing vital support to those who need it most. Every 30 seconds, someone reaches out to their life saving services. They've launched Move for Mental Health (11th-17th May) encouraging people to do: • 30 minutes of movement a day or • 30km + across the week Run, walk, cycle, swim... whatever works for you. If you're already training, you're basically doing it and this gives you the chance to give it some meaning! And if you're not up for the challenge, there's still a way to help. A single text conversation with Shout costs around £10. That £10 could genuinely make the difference for someone in a difficult moment. So if you've ever thought about buying Ben or I a pint... maybe put it towards this instead. And keep an eye out for a group run I'll be hosting to help you reach your target on May 16th 👀  Sign up or support via the link in stories 💙 #run #runner #running #mentalhealth

Có những giải chạy không chỉ đến để phá PR.  Nhưng cũng có những giải chạy khiến mình nhớ vì tình cảm con người… và với Tuấn Quách, Lạng Sơn Marathon KHANH KHE GEOPARK RUN 2026 thật sự là một hành trình nhiều cảm xúc như vậy ❤️ Phải nói đây là lần đầu tiên mình nhận được quá nhiều sự yêu thương khi đến với một giải chạy. Từ bib mời, hỗ trợ lưu trú, cho tới sự đón tiếp cực kỳ nhiệt tình từ các. Ban lãnh đạo tỉnh cảm giác không chỉ là đi race… mà giống như được về một nơi mọi người coi mình như người nhà. Được ăn ngon, được nói chuyện, được giao lưu văn nghệ cùng rất nhiều runners dễ mến. Những câu chuyện rất thật, rất vui vì chuyến đi này trở nên đặc biệt hơn rất nhiều. Cung đường ở Lạng Sơn cũng mang một màu sắc rất riêng. Không khí, con người, cảnh đẹp. Chạy xong còn được mọi người chuẩn bị cả quà đặc sản Lạng Sơn mang về nữa thì đúng là “hết nước chấm” 🫶 Có lẽ điều đẹp nhất của chạy bộ không chỉ nằm ở thành tích… mà là những con người mình được gặp trên hành trình. Cảm ơn KHANH KHE GEOPARK RUN 2026 vì đã cho Tuấn Quách một trải nghiệm quá trọn vẹn — được chạy, được kết nối và mang về thật nhiều cảm xúc đẹp. #tuanquachnagchaybo #chaybo #langson #runners #xakhanhkhe

BỔ TRỢ CHẠY BỘ - Plyometric Sức mạnh không chỉ đến từ chạy nhiều — mà còn từ khả năng bật nhảy, phản xạ và kiểm soát cơ thể 💪 Thực hiện  - Plate Pogos: 20 lần - Lateral Plate Pogo: 15 lần mỗi bên - Plate Toe Taps: 15 lần mỗi bên - Single Leg Plate Pogos: 15 lần mỗi bên - Single Leg Pogo + Jab Step: 10 lần mỗi bên - Lunge to Knee Drive: 8 lần mỗi bên Hoặc nếu ngại đếm rep thì có thể chuyển sang tập theo thời gian: ⏱️ 30 giây tập / 30 giây nghỉ cho mỗi động tác. Plyometric giúp cải thiện tốc độ, sự linh hoạt, khả năng tạo lực và kiểm soát cơ thể. Tu subis tes runs avec cette chaleur ? ☀️ C’est normal… mais y’a quand même 2-3 règles à suivre ! Mes conseils pour courir quand il fait chaud : ☀️ Pars tôt ou plus tard :  évite les heures les plus chaudes 💧 Hydrate-toi avant ET pendant si la sortie est longue 🐢 Ralentis un peu l’allure : oublie un peu le chrono, cours à l’effort (oui c’est OK si ton BPM monte plus vite) 🧂 Pense aux électrolytes si tu transpires beaucoup 🧢 Casquette + lunettes + zones d’ombre = game changer 🔥 Acclimate-toi progressivement : ton corps peut s’habituer à la chaleur, mais pas en un run Petit rappel : avec cette chaleur ton cardio monte plus vite et ton run peut paraître 10x plus dur… mais tu ne régresses pas :) #courirenete #conseilcourseapied

Petit rappel d’été : quand il fait chaud, ton cardio monte plus vite et c’est NORMAL !  Exemple : si d’habitude ton footing facile est à 145 BPM, ça ne veut pas forcément dire catastrophe si tu te retrouves à 155–160 quand il fait chaud.  Ton corps travaille aussi pour se refroidir 😎 Le plus important : - tes sensations - est-ce que tu peux encore parler ? - est-ce que tu te sens bien ou en surchauffe ? Perso si je me sens bien, je ralentis un peu si besoin mais je panique pas juste parce que le BPM est un peu plus haut  Mes règles quand il fait chaud : 💧 partir hydraté ⏰ courir tôt ou plus tard 🐢 accepter de ralentir un peu ❤️ sensations > allure Courir plus lentement l’été ≠ régresser, juste s’adapter ☀️ #courirenete #courirpourleplaisir

Tu cours mais tu fais jamais de renfo ? 👀 Teste juste ces 10 minutes !  Pas besoin d’1h à la salle ou d’un matos de fou : un tapis, un peu de motivation… et de la régularité 🫡 ➡️ Fais le circuit x2 pour une séance complète À quelle fréquence ?   • Minimum : 2x/semaine pour déjà voir une différence   • Perso : tous les matins dans ma prépa 500 km 🥹 Objectif : être plus stable, mieux encaisser les impacts, renforcer les tendons, les chevilles et éviter les petites douleurs :)  Sauvegarde-la pour demain matin 💛 #renfocourseapied

Au début j’avais l’impression de ne jamais progresser… Mais à force d’être régulière, les allures qui semblaient rapides sont devenues mon « tranquille» La progression en course elle se voit pas toujours d’un jour à l’autre… mais avec le temps !!  #commenceracourir #courirpourleplaisir

Les vraies runneuses savent que parfois le plus dur dans une sortie… ce n’est même pas le cardio 😭 Avec les beaux jours et les longues sorties, les frottements peuvent vite devenir un enfer.  Gros coup de cœur pour la crème isolante @URIAGE, qui protège et apaise vraiment la peau ✨ Clairement le genre de détail qui change une séance 💪🏼 #uriage #problemederunner  *collaboration commerciale

500 km… dit comme ça, ça paraît un peu fou 🕺🏻 Mais partir en vacances en courant ça se prépare !  Et cette fois, je vais tout vous partager : entraînements, renfo, récupération et j’en passe  En gros toute la préparation pour relier Paris au sud en courant J-76… 👀

La course à pied c’est bien… jusqu’au moment où faut nettoyer les chaussures 😭 Petite astuce au passage : laissez pas la boue sécher 3 jours ! Un coup de brosse douce + eau tiède juste après le run, et ça part 10x plus facilement (et vos chaussures vous remercieront 😌) Je veux savoir : vous les nettoyez direct ou vous faites semblant de pas les voir pendant 3 jours ?  Perso moi ça dépend 👀
Le nouveau coach running du moment ? La météo 😂 Un peu fière 1 min après être rentrée il a plu 😎 Je touche du bois pour le moment ahah et vous ?!

Je crois que la course à pied est en train de me faire vivre les aventures les plus folles !  Cet été j’ai décidé de partir en voyage… mais pas n’importe comment : EN COURANT   À votre avis, quelle sera ma destination ? ⭐️

Here’s what I’ve learned from 3 years of balancing bodybuilding, Hyrox, and distance running: 1. Patience — periodize your training. Building both physique and endurance takes time. You won’t PR everything at once, so know what you’re prioritizing each phase. Progress will be slower than specialists and that’s okay. 2. Don’t compare — stop measuring yourself against specialists. Compare your lifts, runs, and race times to your past self. Be inspired, but don’t let it take away from your own progress. 3. Stay relentless — you have to want it bad because it’s not easy. While others rest, you’re planning the next session. It takes structure, discipline, and sacrifice. Even on busy days, get something in. Consistency over perfection. This path isn’t clear or easy, but that’s exactly why it’s worth it. Want to get elimate guesswork with your training and nutrition? I'll coach you 1-on-1. Dm me or check link in my bio.

Haven’t uploaded a week of running for a hot minute 🤯 This week I returned to running after having a sore Achilles since March. I began with two run/walk sessions furing the week and then happened to have a running event lined up today 😅 I ended up downgrading from the 12km to the 6km option, took it easy, and managed to run the whole way without needing to walk. I ran steady and tried not to get too carried away, which I can tend to do in race events.  Another physio appointment tomorrow to see where to from here. #run #running #runner #easyrun #strava

3 weeks since Ballarat and I finally went for my first run/walk tonight after being cleared by the physio 👏🏼👏🏼 Tonight’s run consisted of 2 minutes running/1 minute walking x10. You best believe I took it easy and cautious. While recovering, I’ve been keeping my fitness up by cross training and strength training. The goal from here is to simply build my endurance slowly week by week and avoid any speed work for now. I’ll continue my strength training and physio exercises to ensure the pain and injuries don’t return 🤞🏼 #run #running #runner #injury #hallelujah

April was a flop 🫠 hence the lack of motivation to upload this video (better late than never). After such a positive block of training in March, I went downhill in April carrying what I believe is an Achilles injury.  I was forced to downgrade from the Hobart half marathon I’d been training for, to the 10km distance which I managed to complete, but left me in pain the following days. Two weeks later, the Ballarat 10km came along and again, I got through it but it’s not the race I was hoping for. Ballarat Marathon week - 10km event 🏃‍♀️  I wasn’t sure how I’d feel going into this event. After my Hobart 10km race two weeks ago, I had a full rest week with no running to try and calm some Achilles/calf pain I’ve been carrying.  This week I managed two easy runs, however they didn’t feel too easy at all 🤪 the pain started to flare up again and I felt like I was basically hobbling the whole way.  Today the challenging conditions got to me; headwind and the hot midday sun (starting a race at 11:30 is not ideal) 🥵  While I got nowhere near my top 10km times, I was still happy to achieve under 45mins with a net time of 44:50. #run #running #runningevent #ballaratmarathon #ballarat

📍 Freycinet National Park, Tasmania Wineglass Bay Hazards Beach Circuit 🌿🏞️ This is of Tasmania’s most iconic coastal walks for a reason; this loop in Freycinet National Park takes you from the Wineglass Bay lookout down to the white sands below, across to Hazards Beach, and then back through the bushland 🌊🌿 The full circuit is just over 11km and took us around 3 hours of walking (not including the photo stops and a lunch break). It starts with an uphill climb to the Wineglass Bay lookout before descending down to the beach. You then cross the isthmus to Hazards Beach which makes the perfect lunch spot and shell looking spot. The track then loops back through scrub and back to the car park. We were very lucky to have perfect weather on the day we visited ☀️  #wineglassbay #freycinetnationalpark #tasmania #bushwalking #hazardsbeach

Running in Tassie 🏃‍♀️  A bit of a lower weekly mileage after I downgraded from a half marathon to a 10km event. Being on holiday means lots of walking and sightseeing each day so I still kept very active with 45km of walking recorded last week. #run #running #runner #runningstats #training

Hobart Marathon Festival 10km 🏃‍♀️ When there’s a running event on during your family holiday, of course you sign up! The last few months I had been training to run in half marathon, and every thing was going really well; I was hitting my paces during my intervals, enjoying easy runs, and slowly increasing my mileage with a long run each week. A tender Achilles slowed me down the last few weeks and instead of deciding to risk running a half marathon with lots of elevation, I decided to downgrade to the 10km so I could still get involved and enjoy the event with a lot less stress.  Going into the 10km, I ran by feel and really enjoyed myself. It was lot of fun cruising along at a steady pace without having the pressure of a pace to hit each kilometre at. A freezing cold morning, some strong winds, and steep hills, but I got it done and felt great afterwards 💪🏼 #run #runningevent #10km #hobart #hobartmarathon

Dear Reader,   Today I’m choosing gratitude. 🤍   Not because everything is perfect, but because I’m still here. Still breathing. Still becoming. And that alone is something I refuse to take for granted.   I’ve learned that gratitude is not only for the moments that feel good, but also for the seasons that stretched me, broke me, and rebuilt me in ways I didn’t understand at the time. Even in the quiet pain, God was still present. Even in the waiting, something within me was growing.   There is a gentleness in realizing that not everything had to make sense for it to still have purpose. Some lessons only reveal themselves with time, and some healing happens so slowly you only notice it when you look back.   So today, I’m thankful for grace I didn’t earn, strength I didn’t always feel, and a God who never let go of me even when I felt distant from everything. 🤍   And to you, dear Reader, I hope you pause today and find one small thing to be grateful for. It doesn’t have to be big. Sometimes it’s just the fact that you made it through.

Lord, thank You for always being faithful, even in seasons where I could not understand the journey. Through every challenge, every delay, every victory, and every quiet moment, Your hand has never left me. Thank You for carrying me when I felt weak, for providing when I lacked, and for giving me strength to keep going. Your grace continues to sustain me daily, and Your love never fails. I am grateful for the doors You have opened, the prayers You have answered, and even the ones You protected me from. You remain constant, dependable, and true through it all. No matter what life brings, I will always praise You because You have been good to me. 🤍

Dat is wel het laatste wat ik had verwacht toen ik afgelopen zondag aan de start stond van de Wings for life world run . Mijn taak: @Mikky Irene hazen tot 50 kilometer. Uit de wind houden, tempo maken, voeding aangeven en zorgen dat zij zo comfortabel mogelijk kon lopen. Alleen zat er nog een extra uitdaging aan vast… Het werd ook mijn allereerste ultra 😅 De eerste kilometers gingen super soepel. We liepen strak op schema en Mikky oogde sterk. Rond kilometer 25 ging het tempo iets omlaag en vanaf kilometer 35 begonnen mijn benen langzaam zwaar te worden. Maar toen kwam het bericht dat alles veranderde. Bij kilometer 45 kregen we door dat Mikky op dat moment nummer 1 van de wereld lag 🤯 Ik wist dat ik nog maar 5 kilometer hoefde, maar voor Mikky begon het echte gevecht pas. Bij 50 kilometer waren mijn benen helemaal leeg. Ik klokte mijn horloge uit en wenste Mikky succes. Daarna kon ik alleen nog maar kijken. Samen met andere lopers zag ik op het grote scherm hoe ze bleef doorgaan. Nek aan nek met een Duitse loopster. Kilometer na kilometer. De Duitse loopster werd ingehaald door de catcher car en Mikky pakte de wereldwijde overwinning. Uiteindelijk werd ze bij 62.24 kilometer ingehaald door de catcher car en liep ze een wereldrecord.🔥 Hoe bijzonder dat ik een klein onderdeel mocht zijn van zo’n gigantische prestatie. Wat een ongelofelijke kanjer.👏 #wingsforlife #hyundai #ultra #mikkykeetels #all4running @All4running @Hyundai Nederland

อายุเป็นเพียงแค่ตัวเลข อันนี้ "จริง" แต่ขึ้นอยู่กับการเตรียมความพร้อมและรู้จักตัวเอง อายุ 80 ก็ทำได้ แต่ต้องอยู่ในกรอบของคนที่อายุ 80 --อ.ชาญเชาน์ ไชยานุกิจ-- ที่ปรึกษาคณะกรรมการกองทุน สสส. และประธานบริหารแผน คณะที่ 4 . ผู้ที่จบฟูลมาราธอนในวัย 65 ปี และพิชิตสนาม HYROX ในวัย 66 ปี . อะไรคือเคล็ดลับความแข็งแรงและการดูแลตัวเองอยากให้ฟังคลิปนี้ครับ อาจารย์บอกไว้ว่า "การออกกำลังไม่ใช่สิ่งพิเศษ แต่มันคือวิถีชีวิต เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของชีวิต และมันจะทำให้คุณมั่นใจในการใช้ชีวิต รวมถึงไม่ประมาท และต้องทำอย่างสม่ำเสมอ รวมถึงรู้จักตัวเอง" ฟังเถอะ แล้วคุณจะมีกำลังใจในการออกกำลังกายกันมากขึ้น ขอขอบคุณ อ.ชาญเชาวน์ ที่สละเวลามาแบ่งปันเรื่องราวดีๆ กับวิ่งแถวบ้านนะครับ #วิ่งแถวบ้าน #ไม่ใช่นักวิ่งแถวหน้าพวกเราแค่วิ่งแถวบ้าน #วิ่งมาราธอน

เวลาจบมาราธอน คำถามแรกที่มักโดนถามคือ… “จบเวลาเท่าไหร่?” มันเป็นคำถามธรรมดา ไม่มีนัยยะแอบแฝงอะไรหรอก เพราะลึกๆ แล้ว ทุกคนพร้อมชื่นชมกันเสมอ แต่มีผู้ชายคนหนึ่ง สมชาย เข็มกลัด เขามักตอบคำถามนี้เหมือนเดิมทุกครั้งว่า “สนามให้เวลาเท่าไหร่ ผมก็ใช้เท่านั้นแหละ ผมวิ่งช้า…แต่ผมเป็นมนุษย์ไม่คัทออฟ” . หลายคนอาจสงสัย ทำไมเขาถึงวิ่งช้า ไม่ใช่เพราะไม่ซ้อม ไม่ใช่เพราะไม่พยายาม ตรงกันข้าม—เขาคือคนที่ “โคตรพยายาม” แต่ด้วยสภาพร่างกาย หัวเข่าทั้งสองข้างที่เสื่อมหนัก หนักขนาดที่หมอยังไม่อยากให้วิ่งด้วยซ้ำ . แต่เขาก็ยังวิ่ง ด้วยเหตุผลเดียวที่ชัดเจนมาก— เขาอยากจบมาราธอนให้ได้สักครั้งในชีวิต เพื่อพิสูจน์ว่า “ถึงร่างกายจะไม่อำนวย…แต่ใจเขายังไปได้” . ผมรู้จักพี่เต๋าตั้งแต่วันที่เขาประกาศว่า อยากลงมาราธอน จนถึงวันที่เขาทำสำเร็จ World Marathon Majors ครบ 6 ดาว หลายคนอาจมองว่า เขาเป็นดารา มีเงิน มีสปอนเซอร์ แต่ความจริงคือ… เงินซื้อได้แค่โอกาส แต่มันซื้อ “การจบ” ไม่ได้ . เพราะมาราธอนเมเจอร์ ไม่ได้แค่ “เข้าเส้นชัย” แล้วจบ คุณต้องจบให้ทันเวลา (Cut-off) ด้วย จากคนที่แค่ประคองร่างกายให้จบใน 6–7 ชั่วโมงก็ว่ายากแล้ว แต่นี่…เขาต้องทำให้ได้ภายในประมาณ 6–6.30 ชั่วโมง สำหรับคนที่เข่าพังแบบนั้น นี่ไม่ใช่เรื่องธรรมดาเลย . เขาเลือกจะสู้ในแบบของตัวเอง หัวเข่าไม่ดี—ก็เสริมกล้ามเนื้อรอบๆ ให้แข็งแรง น้ำหนักเกิน—ก็ลด ความฟิตไม่พอ—ก็ซ้อมเพิ่ม ถึงขั้นไปลง Ironman และจบ Full Ironman ได้จริง . ลองถามตัวเองดู แค่เราบาดเจ็บนิดหน่อย ฟอร์มตกหน่อย เรายังท้อกันเลย แล้วคนที่ร่างกายมีข้อจำกัดขนาดนั้น เขาต้องใช้ความพยายามมากแค่ไหน ถึงยืนอยู่ตรงจุดนี้ได้ . เขาพูดไว้ชัดมากตลอดเส้นทาง 6 ดาวของเขา “ไม่ว่าคุณจะไปเมเจอร์มาราธอนด้วยวิธีไหน มันไม่ได้ซื้อเหรียญหรือความสำเร็จให้คุณได้ คุณต้องซ้อม ต้องวางแผน และต้องทำมันด้วยตัวเอง” . พี่เต๋า สมชาย ไม่ใช่แค่ดาราศิลปินที่ไปจบเมเจอร์ แต่คือภาพของ ความมุ่งมั่น ความพยายาม และการไม่ยอมแพ้ต่อข้อจำกัดของตัวเอง . “อย่าไปกลัว” คำพูดสั้นๆ ของเขาที่พูดเสมอๆ และเขาใช้ทั้งชีวิตพิสูจน์ให้เห็นแล้วว่า "มันจริง" #วิ่งแถวบ้าน #สมชายจรดปลายเท้า #ครอบครัวเข็มกลัด

ทำไมนักวิ่งส่วนใหญ่ถึงหลงรักระยะ 21 กม. มันมีอะไรบางอย่างในระยะนี้ ที่ทำให้นักวิ่งจำนวนมาก “อิน” แบบอธิบายไม่ถูก 1. ระยะที่เราเริ่มจะ “เอาจริง” 5-10 กม. คือระยะที่ใครก็ลงได้ จะซ้อมหรือไม่ซ้อม ก็พอประคองตัวไปถึงเส้นชัยได้ แต่ 21 กม. มันเริ่มไม่ใช่แบบนั้นแล้ว ถ้าไม่ซ้อม…มีสิทธิ์ “พังกลางทาง” ถ้าไม่วางแผน…มีสิทธิ์ “หมดตั้งแต่ยังไม่ถึงครึ่ง” ระยะนี้เลยเป็นเส้นแบ่งบางๆ ระหว่าง “นักวิ่งเล่นๆ” กับ “นักวิ่งที่เริ่มจริงจัง” 2. ระยะที่ “วิ่งได้ยาว” แต่ “ยังควบคุมได้” มันคือระยะที่ 👉 เราสามารถ “วิ่งด้วยเพซที่ควบคุมได้” 👉 ไม่ต้องอัดสุดเหมือน 10K 👉 แต่ก็ไม่ต้องประหยัดแรงจนเกินไปแบบมาราธอน มันเลยกลายเป็นระยะที่ “วิ่งแล้วสนุก” จริงๆ 3. ระยะที่ “ท้าทายตัวเองแบบพอดี” 21 กม. ไม่ง่าย แต่มันก็ไม่ได้โหดจนเกินเอื้อม มันคือระยะที่ยังไงคุณก็ต้องซ้อม แต่ในขณะเดียวกัน มันก็ยังเป็นเป้าหมายที่ “เอื้อมถึงได้” นี่แหละ…เสน่ห์ของมัน 4. ระยะที่ทำให้คุณ “เริ่มเป็นนักวิ่งจริงๆ” หลายคนเริ่มต้นจาก 5 หรือ 10 กม. แต่จุดที่เขารู้สึกว่า “ฉันเป็นนักวิ่งแล้วนะ” มักจะเกิดขึ้นตอนที่เขาซ้อมเพื่อ 21 กม. เพราะมันไม่ใช่แค่ลงแข่ง แต่มันคือกระบวนการเข้าสู่โหมดซ้อมจริงจังมากยิ่งขึ้นกว่าเดิม มันคือการก้าวข้ามขีดจำกัดบางอย่างของตัวเอง สรุป 21 กิโลเมตร ไม่ใช่ระยะที่ง่ายที่สุด และก็ไม่ใช่ระยะที่โหดที่สุด แต่มันคือระยะที่ “พอดีที่สุด” สำหรับการเติบโตของนักวิ่ง “ถ้าวันนี้คุณยังไม่เคยซ้อมจริงจัง คุณพร้อมจะลอง 21 กม. หรือยัง?” #วิ่งแถวบ้าน #ไม่ใช่นักวิ่งแถวหน้าพวกเราแค่วิ่งแถวบ้าน #การวิ่ง

A lot can change in a year… or eight! 😅  8 years ago I was taking out the trash when, somewhere between the smell of spilled beer and stale popcorn, I made a decision about who I wanted to be when things get tough. As I reflect on that decision, I’m grateful for  friends who encouraged me to look beyond my challenges, realizing that I am more than my struggles and more than my successes. Who I become is mostly a choice. Whether or not I’m divinely loved is not… the only difference I can make in that is where I search for the divine. The challenges you face today don’t have to dictate who you become a year from now, but your mindset certainly will! So, whether you’re living your dream life or taking out the trash, I hope you take a moment to stop scrolling and look for the magic, wonder, and divine love that exists around you today! #transformation #change #motivational #keepgoing #foryou❤️

Si tu ne peux pas répondre précisément, tu cours à l'aveugle.  Et croire que "courir plus dur = progresser plus vite" est l'erreur n°1 que je vois chez 80 % des coureurs. La vérité, c'est que la progression ne se joue pas dans l'intensité permanente. Elle se joue dans ta capacité à varier les allures intelligemment.🧠 Dans ce carrousel, je te détaille les 5 zones d'effort sur lesquelles je construis mes entraînements et ceux de mes athlètes à la @runningacademy. De la récupération active à l'effort maximal, chaque zone a un rôle précis et un objectif spécifique. La règle d'or à retenir : 80 % en endurance, 20 % en intensité. Et pour elle, chaque fois que je pars courir… c’est “pour courir un marathon”. Une vision simple, presque magique.   Qui me rappelle qu’on oublie parfois l’essentiel… Courir, à la base, c’est juste… mettre un pied devant l’autre.   Pas besoin d’être un expert.   Pas besoin d’aller vite.   Juste commencer. Peu importe ton âge, ta condition physique ou l’endroit où tu vis :   tu peux courir n’importe où, n’importe quand.   Mais pas n’importe comment. C’est exactement pour ça que j’ai écrit ce livre. À travers mon expérience en tant que coach, athlète et marathonien, j’ai voulu partager une méthode simple, accessible et concrète.🏅 “De 5 km à 42 km, il n’y a qu’une foulée” Bien plus qu’un guide, c’est un vrai chemin pour t’accompagner :   du premier footing… jusqu’au marathon. Que tu sois débutant total ou déjà coureur, tu y trouveras :   → des plans d’entraînement progressifs📈 → des conseils concrets pour éviter les erreurs 📄 → des clés mentales pour rester motivé 🧠 → et surtout, une approche centrée sur le plaisir. Parce que courir, ce n’est pas seulement performer.   C’est se retrouver, se dépasser, reprendre confiance… à son rythme. 📅 Disponible le 7 mai. 👉 Clique sur le lien en bio pour découvrir le livre…  Et peut-être… faire tes premières foulées 🚀 #livre #coaching #marathon #running

The final long run before the marathon is always stressful.  Your brain tries to convince you that it will be impossible to run a marathon, but you have to explain to it that you put in all the work the last few months. Once you cure your brains amnesia, it will try to sabotage you.  Don’t let it, stick to the pace you planned.  This is why it’s great to add your plan onto your watch and it can remind you when you’re going too fast.  Before you know it, you’ll be at your marathon destination running the race you trained for.

The long run can bring out all the heavy thoughts.  I find it very meditative. You work through these thoughts in your mind, and when it’s over you’re grateful for it all.  The long run is a staple of marathon training, and over the next several weeks my long runs will build towards the TCS London Marathon. Strength training can help you: ✔️ run faster ✔️ reduce injuries ✔️ improve endurance ✔️ build stronger legs You don’t need bodybuilding workouts. You just need strength work that supports your running. This is your sign to lift weights tomorrow 🏃‍♂️💪 Save this for your next training block.

Of course, a 24-second reel won’t show the internal battle of not wanting to train. I could’ve easily stayed in bed. But that’s the value of showing up — you realize everyone is dealing with something, and your excuses aren’t that special. The energy, the shared suffering, and the environment push you to do more. What started as a 45K ride turned into 100K because I felt good and decided to maximize the day — roughly equivalent to a 28K long run in aerobic load. At the end of the day, if you understand the principles, you can bend the rules. Cycling is one way I can keep building for my marathon block while managing fatigue and still getting quality endurance work in. #MarathonTraining #HybridAthlete #EnduranceTraining

One of the things Spartan racing taught me is that you need to expose your body to the demands of the race. If it’s a trail race, you need trail runs. If it’s a hot race, you need to train in the heat. Because if you avoid those conditions, race day will expose you. A lot of performance comes from proving to yourself that you can handle discomfort before the race even starts. 🧠💪 The other part is physical adaptation, teaching your body how to respond under stress. Combine both, and you give yourself the best chance to perform when it matters most. If you need accountability and guidance for your next race, slide me a message. Train fast. Stay strong.

I couldn’t have survived this run without them 🥹 #londonmarathon #family #raceday #run #indian

В беге важную роль играет правильная постановка стопы, так как это влияет на эффективность, скорость и, что немаловажно, на снижение риска травм. Рассмотрим два популярных стиля бега: с пятки и с передней части стопы (или с носка). Бег с пятки - один из самых распространенных способов бега, который характерен для большинства любителей. Опасность: •	Может увеличиваться нагрузка на коленные суставы и поясницу, особенно при неправильной технике. •	Не эффективен для спринтерских дистанций и быстрого бега, так как с этим стилем сложнее развить скорость. Бег с передней части стопы - более эффективен, безопасен и менее энергозатратен. •	При таком стиле бега основная нагрузка приходится на переднюю часть стопы, а не на пятку. Стопа приземляется на землю на переднюю часть стопы. •	При таком варианте снижается нагрузка на колени и поясницу. #тренерпобегу #техникабега #всембег

Un error recurrente y subestimado en la preparación de maratones y medios maratones, es no darle la debida importancia a la suplementacion e hidratación en carrera.  Estos dos aspectos deben tener tanta relevancia como el plan de entrenamiento mismo. Asesórate e infórmate sobre tus pérdidas y requerimientos individuales, no solamente por rendimiento y performance sino por salud.  Entrena tu estrategia nutricional y no improvises el día de la competencia.
Hoy realizamos Test de Sudoración dentro del plan de entrenamiento. Una evaluación clave para optimizar la hidratación personalizada  y seguir afinando los detalles rumbo a Lima 42K 2026.

Por si ya estás cerca o por si tienes la certeza que algún día lo estarás. Decreta el maratón guardando el video y compartiéndoselo a quien quieres que te acompañe o sea testigo del proceso.

Esto te podría estar saboteando antes de competir: ansiedad alta, pocas horas de sueño, piensas demasiado en la carrera y luego el cuerpo siente el peso.  Por experiencia: baja revoluciones y pensamientos negativos, confía en lo que ya hiciste y desconéctate un poco de la obsesión.

Aquí te dejamos un check list con 10 puntos claves para que tengas en cuenta a pocos días o semanas de una competencia importante. Esa carrera que vienes preparando hace tiempo. Detalles que muchas veces se pasan por alto, pero que pueden marcar completamente tu resultado. La idea es simple: llegar listo/a sin dejar nada al azar. Guárdalo para revisarlo antes de tu carrera y compártelo con alguien que también esté en cuenta regresiva 👊🏻 #MarathonTraining

Beim Kölsche Mèlange Marathon heute Morgen war das Wetter wirklich ein Geschenk für Läufer: angenehmer Wind, viele schattige Abschnitte unter den Bäumen und endlich mal keine drückende Hitze. Trotzdem habe ich jeden Kilometer gespürt: Togo sitzt noch in den Beinen. Die intensive Woche, die hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit, die langen Tage und die vielen emotionalen Begegnungen wirken nach. Aber genau dafür laufe ich. Nicht nur für Zeiten und Medaillen, sondern für Menschen, Hoffnung und Kinder, die eine Zukunft brauchen. 🏃‍♂️🌍🙏 #laufenlaufenlaufen #runningmotivation #runningcommunity #glaube #jesus
2 Minuten Hoffnung mit dem Marathon-Pater  #jesus #liebe #impulse #Hoffnung #MarathonPater

--Diese Kinder in Amou Oblo strahlen voller Freude und Hoffnung. ❤️🌍 Sie freuen sich riesig auf ihren neuen Kindergarten, der nun dank vieler Spenden und Marathonläufe Wirklichkeit wird. 18.000 Euro konnten für das Projekt übergeben werden. Damit entstehen nicht nur neue Räume zum Lernen und Spielen, sondern auch dringend benötigte Toilettenanlagen und eine schützende Außenmauer für die Kinder. Wenn man in diese leuchtenden Augen schaut, versteht man sofort: Jeder gelaufene Kilometer hat sich gelohnt. 🙏 Für viele Kinder bedeutet dieser Kindergarten weit mehr als nur ein Gebäude. Er bedeutet Schutz, Bildung, Gemeinschaft und eine echte Zukunftsperspektive. Und genau dafür lohnt es sich zu laufen. 🏃‍♂️❤️ #Hoffnung #Togo #Afrika #liebe #jesus

🍛 „In Togo wird nicht nur der Hunger gestillt – dort wird Gemeinschaft serviert.“ ❤️ Auch das gemeinsame Essen war für uns ein ganz besonderes Erlebnis. Mitten im Dorf, bei tropischer Hitze und hoher Luftfeuchtigkeit, wurden wir mit einer Herzlichkeit empfangen, die tief berührt hat. Es gab traditionelle Speisen aus Togo – frisch gekocht, mit viel Liebe vorbereitet und voller Geschmack. Gegessen wurde gemeinsam, gelacht wurde gemeinsam und man spürte sofort: Essen verbindet Menschen, selbst wenn sie tausende Kilometer voneinander entfernt leben. Während die Kinder um uns herum spielten und lachten, wurde wieder deutlich, wie dankbar viele Menschen dort trotz einfachster Lebensbedingungen sind. Diese Begegnungen machen demütig. Und genau deshalb lohnt sich jeder Marathonkilometer, jede Spende und jede Anstrengung: weil Hilfe nicht nur Gebäude schafft, sondern echte Begegnungen zwischen Menschen. 🌍❤️ #Afrika #Togo #afrikanischeküche #essen #Hoffnung
Meine neue Laufgruppe #laufen #Hoffnung #Kinder #Afrika #Kinderhilfe

Was mich in Togo immer wieder tief berührt, sind die Kinder. ❤️🌍 Heute Morgen liefen plötzlich viele Kinder jubelnd hinter mir her. Sie lachten, winkten, machten Fotos und strahlten über das ganze Gesicht. Aus einem kurzen Lauf wurde ein Moment voller Lebensfreude und Herzlichkeit. Diese Kinder besitzen oft so wenig – und schenken doch so unglaublich viel Freude. Genau deshalb laufe ich Marathon. Für ihre Zukunft. Für Bildung. Für Hoffnung. Wenn man in diese leuchtenden Augen schaut, weiß man sofort: Jeder Kilometer lohnt sich. 🙏🏃‍♂️ #Togo #Afrika #MarathonPater #Kinder #Hoffnung

Heute Morgen um 6.30 Uhr fiel in Aného in Togo der Startschuss zum „Marathon des Royaumes – 2. Togo-KiPa-RUN 2026“. 🌍🏃🏿‍♂️🏃‍♂️ 43 Kilometer lagen vor uns – tropische Wärme, hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit und sogar ein kräftiger Regenschauer unterwegs. Aber alle Läufer kamen gesund und glücklich ins Ziel. 🙏 Besonders schön: Für zwei afrikanische Läufer war es der erste Marathon ihres Lebens. Mit am Start: Azianou Ablamvi – 5:33:14 Ametonou Amèvi Augustin – 5:33:16 Dogbe Eklou Dieu-Donné – 5:34:24 Anagonou Yaovi Raifort – 5:36:03 Pater Tobias Breer – 5:38:02 Danke an Brigitta Trzeczak und das gesamte Team des „Togo Projekte e.V.“ für die tolle Organisation von Start, Ziel und Strecke. Der Lauf war ein starkes Zeichen der Hoffnung für die Kinder in Togo. ❤️ #Afrika #Kinderhilfe #glaube #jesus #Togo

Ein Tag voller Hoffnung in Amou Oblo, Togo. ❤️🌍 Der neue Kindergarten „Jardin d’enfants Hannah“ wurde offiziell übergeben. Über 50 Kinder haben jetzt einen geschützten Ort zum Lernen, Spielen und Träumen. Zur Feier kamen der Präfekt, der Bürgermeister, Vertreter der Schulaufsicht, traditionelle Würdenträger und viele Menschen aus den umliegenden Dörfern. Es wurde gesungen, getanzt und voller Freude gejubelt. Besonders bewegend: die Übergabe eines Spendenschecks über 18.000 Euro, die ich durch Marathon- und Ultramarathonläufe sammeln durfte. 🙏🏃‍♂️ Die leuchtenden Augen der Kinder bleiben unvergesslich. Vielleicht schaffen wir gemeinsam sogar noch die 20.000 Euro-Marke. ❤️ Spendenkonto: Projekt LebensWert Verwendungszweck: Kindergarten Togo IBAN: DE34 3606 0295 0010 7660 36 #Togo #Afrika #MarathonPater #Kinderhilfe #Bildung

Heute den neuen Kindergarten in Amou Oblo in Togo besucht. ❤️🌍 Über 50 Kinder haben jetzt einen geschützten Raum zum Lernen, Spielen und Träumen. Morgen wird der Kindergarten offiziell eingeweiht. Noch laufen die Arbeiten am Büro und an den Toilettenanlagen auf Hochtouren. Wenn man die Kinder lachen sieht, weiß man sofort: Jeder Kilometer, jeder Marathon und jede Spende lohnt sich. 🙏 17.000 Euro konnten bereits gesammelt werden. Vielleicht schaffen wir gemeinsam noch die 20.000 Euro. Auguri a tutte le donne che corrono. 🌹🌈 Nella vita e sulla strada. 🏃‍♀️ GRETA CE L’HA FATTA. Greta ha voluto che l’accompagnassi in questo viaggio . Non per paura di non farcela, ma perché voleva che proteggessi il suo sogno. (42 chilometri non sono mai scontati, neanche per me) E alla fine ho capito una cosa. Non stavo accompagnando io lei. Era lei che stava insegnando qualcosa a me. 🙏 Grazie Greta per avermi condiviso pezzi e posti della tua Bologna correndo. 🙏 Grazie corsa per darmi la forza di essere custode di tutto questo e per darmi passione per divulgarlo. 🙏 Grazie vita per darci la possibilità di avere come preoccupazione quella di correre una maratona. ps Dietro questo minuto di reel ci sono mesi di rinunce, levatacce, disciplina e non è sempre facile.Ma se superate il muro…sappiatelo. È meraviglioso. Tagga una donna che merita questa medaglia. 🏅
In inverno non serve coprirsi di più. Serve coprirsi meglio. Salva questo reel ❄️ e invialo all’amico che si veste troppo e mette anche il K-Way

🇹🇼 💚Ogni corsa è paese. Ma correre la EVA Air Marathon a Taipei, con un amico, urlando jiā yóu 加油 ! tra i grattacieli…è un’altra storia. Grazie @evaair per averci portato dall’altra parte del mondo a scoprire che la corsa non è solo fatica: è connessione, risate, strada sotto i piedi. Perché alla fine correre e ridere sono linguaggi universali. Qual è stata la maratona più “lontana” della tua vita? PS. Per chi non parla taiwanese: jiā yóu 加油 significa Forza! Dai! Aggiungi carburante! Editing (e traduzioni) ovviamente a cura di @Ruben Orlandi  #EVAAirRun #EVAAirMarathon #EVAAirItaly #AD

La maratona non va fatta. Va preparata, vissuta, rispettata. Non è una spunta sulle cose da fare. Non è un reel. È straordinaria proprio perché non è normale. E ogni runner merita che questo messaggio venga ricordato. ps Non fatevi influenzare (male) #correre #maratona #correrepersempre #francescoguerracoach

✈️ Non siamo venuti a Taipei solo per correre. Siamo venuti per vivere, esplorare, assaggiare. Io e @Ruben Orlandi Abbiamo camminato nei mercatini tipici, scoperto cibi che non sapevamo pronunciare, visto quartieri che sembrano il futuro, e incontrato persone che non conoscevamo ma che ci hanno fatto sentire a casa. La corsa ci ha portati qui. Il viaggio ci ha cambiati. Grazie @evaair per aver reso possibile tutto questo. Qual è la città più sorprendente che hai visitato (anche senza correre)?  Raccontamela nei commenti. #EVAAirRun #EVAAirMarathon #EVAAirItaly #AD #incollaborazioneconEVAAi

La corsa non è solo endorfine: oggi sappiamo che dopo l’allenamento il corpo rilascia endocannabinoidi, sostanze che ci fanno sentire euforici, sereni ed energici. È la nostra chimica naturale del benessere. Io lo chiamo sballo da corsa: quel momento in cui capisci che non corri più solo per allenarti… ma perché ne hai il bisogno. Aneddoto: Una volta negli USA lessi vicino a un paio di scarpe la scritta “Attenzione: rischio dipendenza”. All’epoca non capivo. Ora sì. Fuss et al., 2015 – Proc Natl Acad Sci USA Mostra che il runner’s high è mediato dagli endocannabinoidi  più che dalle endorfine, perché attraversano la barriera emato-encefalica e spiegano euforia, analgesia e calma post-corsa. #correre #maratona #telebari

Se fai almeno 3 di questi 7... non stai correndo. Stai costruendo un’identità.  Tagga l’amico che è passato da “aperitivo” a “lunghissimo”. 🎥 Taipei Taiwan #correrepersempre #maratona #mejor #francescoguerracoach

Oggi mi sento felice. Perché la mia più grande preoccupazione è correre una maratona. Ripetilo più volte. In un mondo pieno di problemi, di dolori, di battaglie più grandi di noi, poter dire questo è un privilegio. Poter correre liberi e’ un privilegio. Una mia atleta, prima della sua prima maratona (e l’ultima), scrisse proprio così. Poco dopo la vita l’ha portata via, mentre correva. E quelle parole mi restano addosso come un insegnamento: ricordare che correre è un dono, non un peso. La vita è semplice. E non dobbiamo dimenticarci mai di dire grazie. Di essere qui.

Sei lento? Ma chi è veramente lento? Qual è il tempo giusto, se siamo amatori?  Nell’era della performance, dove anche un gioco ci fa pensare solo al cronometro, dove rischiamo di perdere il divertimento. Dove gli aspiranti runners aspirano a diventare fenomeni più fenomeni dei loro coach. Ricordiamoci perché corriamo. Restiamo amatori.

1h10’ au semi-marathon de Genève et une 13ème place. Pas vraiment ce que j’étais venu chercher… Avant cette semaine, je pensais vraiment être en bonne forme, mais aujourd’hui, j’avais zéro énergie sur la course. Je pense que ça peut être lié à une grosse crise d’allergie que j’ai eue mercredi, dont je n’avais peut-être pas totalement récupéré. Peut-être aussi que le fait d’avoir enchaîné 4 courses en un mois commence à laisser quelques traces. Le corps envoie sûrement quelques signaux : il est temps de récupérer un peu, de reprendre un vrai cycle d’entraînement, et de revenir plus fort sur les prochaines compétitions. Malgré tout, ça reste une très belle course. Merci Genève pour l’accueil, l’ambiance et les encouragements tout au long du parcours, c’était vraiment trop cool. J’en garde un très bon souvenir et j’ai déjà très hâte des prochaines. 🫶🏼🏃‍♂️

From Manila to Subic to the Finals—this journey was never just about one race. 🏃‍♀️💚 I failed to qualify on my first attempt. But I tried again, pushed harder, and stood at that Subic finish line praying I’d made it. When I learned I qualified for the MILO Marathon Finals, I couldn’t believe it. Out of 25 legs across the country, only a select few earn their spot—and I was one of them. The weeks of training, the early mornings, the doubt, the discipline—it all led to Iloilo. Standing at that starting line surrounded by champions, I felt the weight of the journey. Not every kilometer was easy. There were moments my legs screamed and only my heart kept me going. But crossing that finish line? Every sacrifice, every step, every prayer—it was all worth it. The MILO Marathon Finals taught me that we’re capable of so much more than we think. We just have to refuse to give up, even after we fail. To everyone chasing their own finish line: your story isn’t over. Keep showing up. Keep pushing. Your moment is coming. Marathon training forces you to prioritize. More than the distance, that's the challenge. Especially for newer runners. Seriously though-- we are lucky to live in a time with so many run clubs, where people can find community a million different ways. Some of us like bigger groups. Some like smaller. At Great Day, our run clubs focus on smaller, chill crews. Because hype or social status aren't really why we come.

I believe pace bands are the simplest, most reliable way to pace a marathon, especially for first-timers. GPS watches sound good but can be wildly off from crowds, tall buildings, tree cover, sharp turns, and nonstraight courses; those small errors add up over 26.2 miles. I’d rather trust the clock and the mile markers than a device guessing my position. A pace band is just a tiny table of cumulative mile (or km) times based on your goal. If the race clock matches the band, I’m on target. If I’m 10–20 seconds fast early, I slow slightly to save energy. Your pacing strategy is your best chance at seeing how stacked your fitness really is on race day. Don't have a plan yet? Ask away in the comments.

Nothing a run coach likes to hear more than "is this a good heart rate" without any context (*sarcasm*). Heart rate is extremely variable between athletes and is often incorrectly measured via wearables sorry, Garmin!! Aerobic decoupling (pa:HR on TrainingPeaks) can be a fantastic way to measure the progression of your heart rate throughout a session. On a run over 60 minutes, this metric compares the pace/power output to HR ratio from the second half of the run to the first. If that ratio is 0-5%, you're in a comfortable position. 5%+ means your HR elevated too quickly compared to your pace/power output. A negative number means that ratio went down throughout, which probably means there were some confounding variables at play, hills at the beginning.

Corri com o Skechers Aero Razor! Fiz um bom teste correndo com o Skechers Aero Razor rodando 3km de aquecimento e depois engatando um treino intenso intervalado de 15 x 400m. A primeira coisa que me chamou atenção foi o seu peso, no número que usei br40 pesou apenas 184g. Levíssimo! Ele é bem respirável e confortável. Pra ficar bem ajustado eu usei 1 número maior. O que me agradou mais foi sua sensação de corrida. Sou muito fã da marca, desde os tempos do Go Run Razor 3 Hyper e este me trouxe sensações semelhantes, porém mais tecnológicas. Com a sua espuma Hyperburst PRO senti um bom amortecimento, uma passada mais firme, do jeito que eu curto, sem ser muito molengão. Amorteceu bem durante a rodagem leve e respondeu rápido aos estímulos do treino intervalado. Curti! Ele também tem uma boa estabilidade proporcionada pela placa de carbono diferente, em formato de H que tem esta função de dar mais estabilidade na passada sem perder a flexibilidade. Vejo nele um modelo muito versátil, que você pode utilizar nas suas rodagens, treinos longos, meias e maratonas. Também dá pra usar nos seus treinos mais intensos sem problemas. Ele vai te entregar uma ótima sensação de corrida (desde que você treine direitinho também, né?! 😂) Ela já está disponível no mercado e seu preço de lançamento é de R$ 949,99. #maniadecorrida #SkechersAeroRazor #ConfortThatPerforms #Skechers

Hospede-se perto da largada. A gente sempre prefere se hospedar perto da largada em provas que possuem largada e chegada em lugares diferentes pois você minimiza muito as chances de algum imprevisto, de um trânsito que vai atrasar a sua chegada na arena, da falta de uber ou táxi por conta da demanda da própria corrida e por ai vai. Sem contar que estar hospedado perto da largada te permite dormir um pouco mais e todo descanso pré prova é bem-vindo. E depois da prova feita, ai o Uber pode demorar um poquinho mais pra voltar, o trânsito pode estar caótico, que com a medalha no peito, nada mais vai te afetar! A year ago I started running again because deep down I knew I was losing myself. I felt empty. Out of shape. No purpose. Just waking up every day feeling stuck and slowly becoming someone I didn’t even recognize anymore. Then I got chosen to run the BPM Ultra… and for some reason that moment changed everything for me. It gave me something to fight for again. Since then I’ve been running 30-40 miles every single week, and somewhere in all those lonely miles I found myself again. Running didn’t just make me healthier. It pulled me out of a dark place mentally. It gave me discipline, peace, confidence, and purpose when I needed it most. Sometimes God puts one opportunity in front of you that completely changes the direction of your life #transformation #fyp

Este domingo, en Lima, voy a correr la última maratón del circuito 🥹. Esta maratón representa todo lo que pude reconstruir. Hoy les puedo decir que el running me salvó. En mi caso, esta es la combinación que mejor me funciona: aproximadamente 200 g de carbohidratos acompañados de una fuente de proteína magra. Running the Boston Marathon 🦄 such an incredible weekend and experience. Thank you to every single person who was out there!!! I was never an athlete or a runner growing up, so never knew what it was like to be part of such a cool and supportive community 🥹  Really wanted to have fun during the race, and did that! Truly didn’t know if I’d make it here due to injuries but got it done ✅  If you’ve been following for a while, you’ve seen me go thru a lot. Let this be a reminder to you to NEVER give up on yourself. Use your pain + suffering as fuel to live the life you deserve  #bostonmarathon #runninginfluencer #running #mentalhealthawareness

Life update: ran the 2026 Boston Marathon and miraculously pulled a 3-minute marathon PR too!  Such an incredible weekend. The energy was ⚡️ in Boston. I’m learning what running is all about: the community, supporting each other, meeting new people, and pushing your limits!!  Thank you SO much to all my friends and family who reached out with kind messages and supported me through this journey ❤️  Shoutout to my mom for being there before + after the race for support  Big shoutout to Alex for being the GOAT and coaching me the last year.  HUGE shoutout to @Nigel from Xyzal for the opportunity to run this and making this possible!  Running 26.3 miles is NOT for the weak. To be completely honest with you, I’m so happy to be taking a break from running, having more mental headspace, and reevaluate my relationship with this sport.  I’m 100% confident I will be back eventually to conquer miles 22-26, and go sub 4, and hit some other milestones that I care about. But now it’s time to heal, recover, and focus on some other areas of my life 💯 It’s crazy what happens when you just don’t give up. Life is a trip.. more recaps coming sooon  #bostonmarathon #milestone #running #endurancesports #mentalhealth

🚨WHY 99% OF RUNNERS DON’T NEED HIGH MILEAGE!! ⚡️First off— I think 99% of runners can continue progressing beautifully without having to go into high mileage. ⚡️High Mileage can be a tough one— it’s much harder on your body, it’s exhausting, it is tough to fit in if you have a job, the extra pounding/miles can put you at greater risk for injury, & it’s easy to accidentally dip into overtraining with high mileage. ⚡️High mileage ALSO REQUIRES a good aerobic history background. And most of us amateur adult runners may not be coming in with that. 👉🏽For example— I was a NEW runner at 29 years old. I had NOT been active at all (unless you count clubbing every night in law school). So then I went from COMPLETELY inactive to 70 miles a week that first year. That just slowed me down. I also TOTALLY skipped the speed component of running that EVERY SINGLE PRO starts with (assuming they run in high school & college). So basically, I totally tired myself out because it was TOO MUCH for me at the moment. ⚡️If you’re running at the elite level— like my husband @tunderface, I believe you do NEED the high mileage. It’s a different level of running though. He is running 2:18 marathons— he also has a LONG history of being super active in sports— so when he runs high mileage, it’s not an overload for him. 👉🏽I guess my take is — why do more/risk injury & overtraining, when I KNOW that I can continue progressing doing speed & less mileage which I also enjoy more! ⚡️For most runners, I think smartly developing as a runner— focusing on speed first and slowly building the base is the way to go. It seems like the answer everywhere is HIGH MILEAGE— but I think that’s like asking a beginner math student to jump into calculus— they don’t have the history/experience to make that jump safely. 🗣How do y’all feel about high mileage? 🤠FAST guides are the BEST to get you faster! They combine @tunderface & my 26 marathon (& countless half + 5k/10k) experience & cutting more than 5 hours off our marathons (Tyler: 4:10 👉🏽 2:18, Kim: 6:08 👉🏽3:11). Und auch Ernährung spielt eine Rolle: Ich achte darauf, genügend Omega-3 aufzunehmen und das Verhältnis zu Omega-6 im Blick zu behalten – um entzündliche Prozesse im Körper zu regulieren. Dieses Rennen hat mir drei Dinge gezeigt, die ich so noch nie erlebt habe. (Anzeige) 1️⃣ Meine Beine am Ende. Ab Kilometer 200 wird es für die meisten zur Qual. Für mich waren die letzten 40 Kilometer die besten des ganzen Rennens. 2️⃣ Meine Füße. Normalerweise sind bei Ultras über 200 km massive Blasen fast unvermeidlich. Dieses Mal: eine einzige Blase – und ansonsten Füße, die vor und nach dem Rennen fast identisch aussahen. 3️⃣ Die Regeneration danach. Drei Tage nach dem Zieleinlauf war ich schon wieder auf einer Bergwanderung am Tegernsee unterwegs. So habe ich das nach solchen Distanzen noch nie erlebt. Ich bin das Rennen im U-TECH Nevos 3 und im U-TECH Vichara von True Motion gelaufen und habe im Rennen sogar die Schuhe gewechselt – etwas, das ich sonst nie mache. Wie lange würdet ihr brauchen, um wieder zu laufen? #running #fyp #brazil135 #ultramarathon #truemotionrunning

Mission Big Five. Beendet mit dem Wissen: Das hier war ziemlich sicher das letzte. Dieser Lauf hat mir alles abverlangt. Vielleicht war es sogar der schwerste meines Lebens. Dann im Ziel zu realisieren, dass ich es auch mit 67 noch schaffen kann, über 100 Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer hinter mir zu lassen – das ist einfach unglaublich. Und ihr wart mindestens genauso unglaublich. Mit über 100.000 Abonnentinnen und Abonnenten im Ziel zu stehen. Tausende Motivationsnachrichten zu lesen. Dieses Mitfiebern von allen Seiten – absoluter Wahnsinn. Danke an mein Frau Christine und meine ganze Familie. Danke an meine großartigen und unverzichtbaren Betreuer, ohne die dieses Finish nicht möglich gewesen wäre. @juliiamoreira @dresanogueira @xxraxfaelxx @juliankopf99  Und danke an das Kamerateam – die Doku wird der Wahnsinn. @julian_zimmermann_ @athlete_x_hub @jxaxsxpxexr  Wenn ihr das Projekt noch unterstützen möchtet: Das Trikot kann ab sofort gekauft bzw. vorbestellt werden. Động lực tập luyện của mọi người là gì?#thethaomoingay #boi #boiloi #hocboi #xuhuong

Nhiều học viên tìm đến An với một điểm chung: Rất muốn biết bơi nhưng lại cực kỳ SỢ NƯỚC. Cứ bước xuống hồ là người tự động cứng đơ, nhịp thở loạn xạ vì sợ chìm, sợ sặc. Mọi người biết không, ép một người đang sợ hãi phải bơi đúng kỹ thuật là điều bất khả thi. Lựa chọn của An trong suốt 7 năm đứng lớp không phải là làm một HLV thét ra lửa, mà là làm một người bạn đồng hành. Lớp của An áp dụng triết lý: "Học mà chơi, chơi mà học". Chúng ta sẽ chơi khởi động trên bờ cho toát mồ hôi, cười đùa cho vơi đi sự căng thẳng, rồi mới từ từ bước xuống khu vực nước nông. Khi tâm lý được cởi trói, cơ thể thả lỏng, tự nhiên mọi người sẽ thấy lướt đi dưới nước nhẹ tênh!#thethaomoingay #boi #hocboi #boiloi #xuhuong
Học bơi quá dễ với Chú An luôn.#thethaomoingay #boi #hocboi #boiloi #xuhuong
BƠI LỘI KHÔNG BẮT ĐẦU TỪ DƯỚI NƯỚC.#thethaomoingay #boi #hocboi #boiloi #hocboicungan
Hồ bơi không chỉ là nơi học bơi. Đó còn là nơi cho  các con được tự do bay lượn mà không sợ vấp ngã.#thethaomoingay #boi #hocboi #boiloi

Ở lớp của An có một luật  hơi ngược đời: KHÔNG BAO GIỜ ép học viên xuống nước khi tâm lý chưa sẵn sàng!  Thỉnh thoảng An lại thấy cảnh các bé mếu máo bám chặt lấy thành hồ rồi bị "bê" thẳng xuống nước.    Hoặc mấy chị em mặt tái mét, người cứng đơ nhưng vẫn bị giục "Cứ buông tay ra đi, không chìm đâu!". Nhìn mà xót thực sự mọi người ạ. An không làm thế.  Tuyên ngôn của An trong nghề này rất rõ ràng:  "Điều hòa cảm xúc trước khi dạy kỹ năng". Bởi vì khi não bộ đang bật chế độ "BÁO ĐỘNG ĐỎ" vì hoảng sợ, thì anh có dạy kỹ thuật giời, đi chăng nữa, người ta cũng chữ thầy trả thầy hết.  Đứa bé bị ép quăng xuống nước hôm nay, rất có thể sẽ trở thành người lớn mang bóng ma tâm lý sợ nước hàng chục năm sau. Thế nên ở lớp của An: Mình làm bạn trước, làm thầy sau. Mình ngồi trên bờ chơi game, té nước, làm quen nhịp thở trước. Bao giờ ánh mắt học viên giãn ra, nụ cười xuất hiện, cảm thấy nước là bạn, và ông An này đủ an toàn để trao niềm tin... thì lúc đó thầy trò ta mới xuống hồ. Chậm 15 phút ban đầu, nhưng đổi lại là sự tự tin bơi lội cả một đời. Đánh đổi này quá xứng đáng đúng không cả nhà nhỉ ?#thethaomoingay #boi #boiloi #hocboi #hocboicungan

La récupération c’est la partie de l’entraînement dont on parle le moins. On pense que c’est juste « rien faire ». Alors que quand on enchaîne les grosses sorties et les courses, le corps accumule. La fatigue, les micro-traumatismes, le système digestif sollicité, les jambes lourdes. Si on ne prend pas le temps de bien récupérer entre deux, on arrive à l’objectif suivant avec un corps déjà entamé. Et un corps entamé c’est un corps qui se blesse. En tant que kiné je vois ça au cabinet bien trop souvent. En tant que coureuse je l’ai compris sur le terrain. Alors j’ai construit mon propre protocole avec mes habitudes. Celui que j’applique après chaque grosse sortie ou chaque course ⭐️ Et toi c’est quoi tes ptits tips secrets ? @OVERSTIM.s -15% avec le code EMMA-OV15 (code affilié)

9 semaines sur 30. Et toujours aucune idée de comment je vais tenir 100 km.  Avec @Campus.Coach et Mathieu Blanchard (pinch me 🤯), j’ai une prépa hyper carré et adaptée à laquelle je fais full confiance ! 680km et +10 000 m de D+ parcouru, 6 séances/sem… et surtout beaucoup d’apprentissage. La nutrition en course + l’aisance en descente reste clairement un axe de travail. Mai va être intense : 3 week-ends. 3 courses. 3 formats. 1 objectif : apprendre et accumuler de l’expérience. ⭐️ Toujours 1 mois OFFERT sur l’offre training Campus Coach avec le code EMMARUN - code à rentrer sur le site (lien en bio) ⚠️ Disclaimer kiné : Enchaîner 3 week-ends de course >30 km n’est pas anodin ! Ce type de charge est possible pour moi aujourd’hui car il est adapté à mon volume d’entraînement, à mon historique et à la connaissance de mon corps. Ce n’est pas à reproduire sans adaptation individuelle. Chaque athlète est différent, et je ne souhaite pas que ce contenu crée de la comparaison ou pousse à faire des choix inadaptés 🫶 Collaboration commerciale

strength work is just as important  if you are new to hybrid training and are starting to run, please don’t stop doing your strength work. It doesn’t have to be a lot, but these are things I try to incorporate every single week: 1️⃣ Calf work. Single leg calf raises (straight & bent knee). 2️⃣ Single Leg strength  Step ups, Bulgarian split squats, single leg RDL, lunges, B-stance hip thrusts  3️⃣ Compound lifts Hip thrusts, RDLs, squats, box squats, cleans  4️⃣ Banded, isolated work banded clams, hip flexor strength, knee stabilisation  All of these exercises are programmed into my Half Marathon program, Hyrox program (Compete) & Hybrid. how I stay injury free ⚡️ I am very thankful that I have never sustained an injury from training (apart from a broken hand playing touch football when I was younger) 🙃 With how common injuries are online at the moment, I am always asked how I avoid it. As I build towards the Gold Coast half marathon with @Beforeyouspeak Coffee and my half Ironman, it’s important that I keep nailing these things. 1️⃣ Strength train as well as your running.  2️⃣ Be smart with your sessions. Don't just do more for the sake of doing more. Make sure each session serves a purpose 3️⃣ FUELLLLL. If you're in the performance space, when your training volume goes up, so does your food 4️⃣ Sleep. You often don't need fancy recovery systems 5️⃣ If wanting to build up volume a lot, seek the help of a coach who someone who can help you increase load safely 6️⃣ Don't stack too many hard days in a row. Make sure you alternate days with easy days too 7️⃣ Learn proper form in the gym. 8️⃣ Until you have been doing it for years, don't sign up to a million things and think you can do everything. Work your way up to it code ANNABELLE to save on coffeeee ☕️☕️

🏁 1. Démarre ultra progressif Les 2 premiers km doivent te sembler presque “trop faciles”. C’est comme ça qu’on construit une endurance solide. 💨 2. Respire en rythme avec tes foulées Inspire sur 3 pas, expire sur 2 : ton corps trouve un tempo stable, ton mental aussi. 🧠 3. Fractionne mentalement ta sortie Ne pense pas “20 km”, pense “5 fois 4 km”. Ton cerveau adore les étapes intermédiaires. 👣 4. Allège ton appui au sol Imagine que tu veux courir “silencieusement”. Moins de bruit = moins d’impact = plus d’économie d’énergie. ⚙️ 5. Garde une cadence fluide Autour de 170–180 pas/min, même à allure cool. C’est le secret pour économiser les jambes. 🧃 6. Anticipe la nutrition, ne la subis pas Prends une petite gorgée d’eau et un gel toutes les 45 min (sur les séances d’intensité) 🌬️ 7. Détends tes épaules et tes bras La crispation consomme une énergie folle. Imagine que tu tiens deux chips entre les doigts — sans les casser 🤌 🪫 8. Marche 20–30 secondes avant de subir Mieux vaut relancer frais que finir à l’agonie. Les pros aussi marchent parfois. 🧩 9. Reste concentré sur un repère visuel proche Un virage, un arbre, une pancarte… puis un autre. Le cerveau aime les mini-objectifs. 💤 10. Travaille ton endurance à l’effort… en dehors de l’effort Sommeil, récupération, respiration lente : c’est là que tu construis ton moteur. 👉  Perso le tips de la Chips a été un game changer pour moi 🔥 #running #run #course

🔥 Connaître ton potentiel marathon grâce à une seule séance, c’est possible. ➡️ Le test « Yasso » te permet d’estimer ton chrono théorique sur marathon à partir d’intervalles de 800 m. Protocole 10 x 800m recup = 1/2 du temps d’effort  👉 Exemple : si tu fais tes 10x800 m en 3’30”, ton potentiel est autour de 3h30 sur marathon. Test plutôt fiable, si tu fais une prépa cohérente 🫡 ——— Si tu veux un accompagnement personnalisé pour progresser, rejoins les Futures Flèches 🏹 👟 Coaching course à pied en ligne avec un coach diplômé — clique sur le lien dans ma bio.
Rassurez moi je suis pas seul ?

👉 1️⃣ Le footing : ta base. Fais-le en endurance fondamentale, c’est-à-dire entre 65 et 75 % de ta FC max, ou à une allure où tu peux parler sans être essoufflé. Durée : 20 à 40 minutes, selon ton niveau. C’est cette zone qui développe ton système aérobie, améliore ta récupération, et te rend plus efficace sur les allures plus hautes. Bref, ne le néglige pas — même si tu as l’impression de trottiner 🧘‍♂️ 👉 2️⃣ La séance d’intervalles : ton moteur. C’est ici que tu vas stimuler ta V̇O₂max et ta capacité à maintenir une allure plus élevée. Quelques exemples de formats efficaces : 	•	8x400 m , récup 1’ 	•	5x1000 m @ , récup 1’30 	•	10x1’ vite / 1’ lent ou des 30-30 Le but : rester maîtrisé, pas à bloc, mais en effort soutenu et régulier. 👉 3️⃣ La sortie longue : ton endurance. C’est elle qui construit ta caisse. La durée dépend de ton objectif : 	•	Si tu prépares un 10 km → 1h00 à 1h15 	•	Un semi → 1h15 à 1h45 	•	Un marathon → jusqu’à 2h00 voire plus ⏱️ N’hésite pas à y glisser quelques rappels d’allure (ex : 2x10 min allure objectif en fin de sortie) pour habituer ton corps à courir longtemps efficacement. 💡 L’important : la progressivité. Commence simple, monte en charge petit à petit, et surtout respecte tes récupérations. Avec 3 séances bien calibrées, tu peux déjà faire exploser ton niveau !

My confidence, happiness, and health said 📈

Some pictures make it to social media and some will get delete because society convinced us (and myself) that our bodies don’t look “good enough” to post. It has taken me a long time to realize how much social media can distort reality. Angles, poses, lighting, sucking in, standing a certain way… so many of the pictures we see online are carefully chosen versions of a moment. But the “deleted” pictures are real too. Realistically, our bodies are not meant to look perfect in every position, every angle, or every second of the day. My body is meant to carry me through life. It wakes up every morning, works hard, allows me to run marathons, travel the world, love the people around me, and experience life fully. And that alone makes it beautiful. I’m learning to stop letting a bad angle ruin a good memory. I’m learning that my worth is not determined by how flat my stomach looks sitting down or how “social media worthy” a picture is. So here’s to loving ourselves in the posted pictures and the deleted ones too. Because we deserve to be remembered happy, not just perfect 💌

If you can run fast enough at Boston, you can run it again next year. That’s what I plan on doing for the rest of time and I can always count on my family to support my constant chase for Unicorn hardware. My heart rate data is promising. A consistently slow-rising heart rate with an avg HR that sits at the top of my Z3 makes me super happy. Factor in both the ups (4 major Newton hills) and downs (2 45-second bathroom stops). I split 1:20:00 at Half. Couldn’t fight off major cramps in the back half, but super pleased with my 2nd Boston.

My 2nd Boston Marathon back in Mass and it gets even more electric every time. Plenty of friends and family cheering along the way, in addition to the best part of the race: strangers cheering for you. Fun morning with @moxi3_blake @dr.monpere before diving off into another 2:40 attempt. This one was a doozey, if you know what I mean 💩. 2:43:46, see you next year.

Quick bib pickup for my 2nd Boston Marathon at the expo. Dad fangirled over Tyler the runner. Mom bought the merch. I will run the Boston Marathon every year that I am capable. Tudo o que eu como para conseguir cumprir uma planilha de 50km semanais de corrida, 2 treinos de natação e 3 treinos de fortalecimento. Faço em média 6-7 refeições por dia e minha nutri distribui a quantidade de proteína, carbo entre essas refeições. Mas para sair tudo certinho mesmo, preciso me planejar na hora das compras para não faltar nada! Por isso, eu encontro a @Bio Mundo  mais proxima de mim. Lá encontro produtos a granel, wheys, snacks, vitaminicos... tudo o que preciso na rotina 💚 #BioMundo #TemNaBio Publi

Muita gente acha que evoluir na corrida é só treinar mais… mas às vezes os detalhes fazem toda diferença!  Nesse vídeo eu mostro 4 passos simples que me ajudam a deixar os treinos mais confortáveis e eficientes: pré-treino 40min antes de correr, mobilidade das articulações, aquecimento de 10min correndo e a escolha do tênis ideal. Inclusive, tenho usado o Cloudmonster 3 da On, que tem me ajudado bastante pela combinação de amortecimento + retorno de energia, deixando a corrida mais fluida e confortável. Agora me conta, qual desses passos você costuma pular? 👀 @on #On #DreamOn *publi

Esses dias me deparei com uma GRANDE oportunidade... me doeu recusar... mas ela ia me desviar do caminho que preciso e me propus a traçar ate os próximos 3 anos, pelo menos! Ia me destrair, me atrasar e me sobrecarregar... Vi outras pessoas aceitando essa oportunidade e seguindo a vida!  Mas precisamos parar de olhar pro lado e ter coragem de dizer não para o que não faz sentido para nós no momento! Saber o que você quer de forma CLARA e focar nisso vai te fazer chegar mais rapido. Nem toda oportunidade é para você, você não precisa aceitar todas, você precisa do essencial para sua jornada 🤍
